purpose: Preserve the evidentiary meaning of the current File Library search for M-004, M-005, and M-006 without promoting numeric-suffix collisions or search non-results into provenance conclusions.
sources_inspected: File Library semantic and exact-token search for M-004, M-005, M-006, continuity provenance, decision log, language lexicon, and assigning source

observed: The current File Library search returned V8-004/V8-005/V8-006 and V9-004/V9-005/V9-006 proof-machine records, but no result carrying the exact M-004, M-005, or M-006 namespace.
The returned numeric suffixes belong to mathematical proof-machine record families whose prefixes, semantic roles, and source domains differ from the continuity identifiers.
The current search also returned unrelated chat and compiled-site material, demonstrating that semantic retrieval broadens recall beyond authoritative provenance candidates.
inferred: A File Library retrieval hit is a candidate-discovery event, not an authority event.
Exact numeric suffix agreement without namespace, semantic-role, and authority agreement has near-zero provenance value for these continuity identifiers.
A non-result for the exact M namespace is coverage-bounded because File Library indexing, semantic ranking, duplicate uploads, and unavailable chat history are not an exhaustive corpus traversal.
proposed: Record File Library searches as query receipts containing query text, returned object identity, namespace classification, semantic-role classification, and explicit coverage limits.
Require an exact M-prefixed identifier plus assigning-language evidence before promoting any File Library object from collision or lead to provenance candidate.
superseded: Treating suffix-only matches such as V8-004 or V9-004 as candidate sources for M-004.
Treating a File Library exact-token non-result as proof that no assigning chat, lexicon, decision log, or project document exists.
unresolved: No authoritative File Library object assigning M-004 was located.
No authoritative File Library object assigning M-005 was located.

contradiction_resolution.resolved: High lexical similarity in numeric suffixes can coexist with total identity mismatch; retrieval similarity is not provenance identity.
contradiction_resolution.preserved_boundary: File Library evidence may generate leads, reject collisions, or confirm language evolution, but cannot establish repository-wide absence or authoritative identifier assignment without immutable locator and authority evidence.

privacy.boundary: Only file titles, abstract namespace classifications, retrieval behavior, and provenance conclusions are retained; no private chat text or uploaded file content is copied.

falsification_route: Locate a File Library object with the exact M-004, M-005, or M-006 token in an assigning context, establish its source identity and temporal precedence, and reconcile it with an immutable repository or export locator that passes namespace, authority, semantic-role, and provenance tests.
